Flyout.use: pick one option from a side panel, no portal

rules.options: Array of {value, label, disabled?}; controls both the trigger's selected label and the panel's items — there is no separate children API.
rules.value: Controlled: pass value + onValueChange. Omitting value makes it uncontrolled from defaultValue (or the first option).
rules.indicator: Decorative glyph for the closed trigger state (e.g. a chevron-down Icon), omit Icon.label — Flyout owns the accessible name via its own label prop.
rules.openIndicator: Decorative glyph swapped in while the panel is open (e.g. chevron-up); paired with indicator.
rules.itemIndicator: Decorative glyph shown next to the currently selected item inside the panel (e.g. a check).
rules.portal: Unlike Select/Combobox/Menu, the panel is NOT portaled — it participates in normal document flow next to the trigger. Prefer Select when the panel must escape an overflow:hidden ancestor.
rules.exclusive: Only one Flyout stays open at a time across the page; opening one closes any other open Flyout automatically.

Flyout.basic: <Flyout label="Plan" value={plan} onValueChange={(d) => setPlan(d.value)} indicator={<Icon name="chevron-down" />} openIndicator={<Icon name="chevron-up" />} itemIndicator={<Icon name="check" />} options={[{ value: "starter", label: "Starter" }, { value: "pro", label: "Pro" }]} />
